additional_runs.why: paper Tab.7 'Ours' uses appearance, the released nerfonthego.yml disables it: both rows are needed to resolve the conflict

protocol control (no shared baseline); score with python -m ss_wildgaussians.evaluate --run RUN (auto protocol: On-the-go full image; Photo Tourism right half, no test-time optimisation possible) for the same official metrics

evaluation: after training run `tools/ssenv python -m ss_wildgaussians.evaluate --run RUN` (writes RUN/test_wild.json; headline = metrics.official; Photo Tourism uses the NeRF-W left/right-half protocol automatically). ss-eval numbers are raw untoned renders and are NOT the paper protocol.
notes: Not registered in tools/datasets.json; pass --data directly or register. Put run dirs under /bigdata/sejain/runs with a symlink. Expect ~3x gsplat time per step (DINO ViT-S + two raster passes); PT 200k steps is long (~5 it/s early on a busy A6000), ~9 GB host RAM for images + ~5 GB DINO cache.
